text:
Add a check that runs after the producer finishes and before the verifier. For each job id named in lines the diff adds to CHANGELOG.md or to code comments, confirm the job exists under records/jobs. Send any id that is not found back to the producer as a failing item. In the producer brief, add one rule: every fact about a recorded job that you write in a changelog or comment (a count, a cause, an outcome) must come from that job's record, and your report must cite the record path. Test the check with a fixture changelog that names a missing job id (refused) and one that names an existing id (passes). Add a CHANGELOG.md entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Changelog entries and code comments state facts about recorded jobs (counts, causes, outcomes) that the records contradict, caught only at the final verdict
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: CHANGELOG.md, records/jobs.
